title: Ending: the window is dark (with the doorway)
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
Night. The stone house on the cliff at the left with one dark window and a black silhouette of another figure standing in its lit doorway; on the quay in front, the returning sailor (a weathered, grey-bearded seaman in a navy pea coat, flat navy cap, red neckerchief, grey trousers and black boots; match mood-sailor-1) alone, throwing a small stone into the bay, rings spreading on the water. All three must be clearly visible. Replaces ending-dark, which is missing the doorway. A painted toy-theatre tableau seen square-on, full bleed to every edge, scene painting in the manner of Georges Méliès' 1903 film Le Royaume des fées; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 slightly out of register; faint film grain; no lettering.
Requested final aspect ratio 2560:1440. Opaque full-bleed scene; paint right to every boundary.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark.
